title: feat(client): Complete @objectstack/client to cover full spec API surface
body:
Client SDK covered ~51% of the spec protocol (26/51 methods across 7/14 domains). This adds the remaining namespaces and query builder enhancements to reach full spec compliance.

### New namespaces

- **`permissions`** — `check`, `getObjectPermissions`, `getEffectivePermissions`
- **`realtime`** — `connect`, `disconnect`, `subscribe`, `unsubscribe`, `setPresence`, `getPresence`
- **`workflow`** — `getConfig`, `getState`, `transition`, `approve`, `reject`
- **`views`** — `list`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `delete`
- **`notifications`** — `registerDevice`, `unregisterDevice`, `getPreferences`, `updatePreferences`, `list`, `markRead`, `markAllRead`
- **`ai`** — `nlq`, `chat`, `suggest`, `insights`
- **`i18n`** — `getLocales`, `getTranslations`, `getFieldLabels`

### Auth enhancements

- `auth.register(request)` — user registration with auto-token-set
- `auth.refreshToken(refreshToken)` — token refresh with auto-token-set

### QueryBuilder / FilterBuilder enhancements

- **QueryBuilder**: `.expand(relation, subQuery?)`, `.search(query, opts?)`, `.cursor(cursor)`, `.distinct()`
- **FilterBuilder**: `.between(field, min, max)`, `.contains(field, value)`, `.startsWith(field, value)`, `.endsWith(field, value)`, `.exists(field)`

### Usage

```typescript
const client = new ObjectStackClient({ baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com', token });

// Permissions
const { allowed } = await client.permissions.check({ object: 'order', action: 'delete', recordId: '123' });

// Workflow
await client.workflow.transition({ object: 'order', recordId: '123', transition: 'submit' });

// Views CRUD
const views = await client.views.list('customer', 'list');

// QueryBuilder with new methods
const query = createQuery<Customer>('customer')
  .select('name', 'email')
  .where(f => f.contains('name', 'alice').between('age', 18, 65))
  .expand('orders', { fields: ['total', 'status'] })
  .search('premium')
  .distinct()
  .build();
```

All methods follow existing SDK patterns: `getRoute()` → `fetch()` → `unwrapResponse()`. Request/response types imported from `@objectstack/spec/api` and re-exported for consumers. 50 unit tests (44 new), all passing.
